by: insolvency (fork of integrator-9d788fb), step 8.4's lane once subscribed; to be appended by the integrator at the merge
title: One estate's public detail from the Insolvency Register API (GET /insolvencies/{estate-id}, JSON), landed with every address field and the month and year of birth taken out

landmarks: a JSON object carrying estateNumber and insolvencyTypeDescription or insolvencyStatus
no searchResults and no removedOrCorrectedInsolvencies key
a person's estate names estateName; a company's (a liquidation the Official Assignee administers) organisationName, nzbn, companyNumber

signals_note: Landed by registers.insolvency.capture through the fetch gate; read.recognise takes it by its keys. An answer with neither estateNumber nor the type or status is not this shape and is a failed read.
notes: Fields from the API's definition (portal.api.business.govt.nz, operation getInsolvencyDetail and the removals example, read 2 November 2026): estateNumber, estateName, organisationName, nzbn, companyNumber, adjudicationOrLiquidationDate, insolvencyTypeDescription, insolvencyStatus, multipleInsolvencies, tradingNames, alternateNames, occupationAtAdjudicationOrIndustryAtLiquidation, courtName, dischargeOrCompletionDate, dischargeOrCompletionType, dischargeSuspended, annulmentDate, officeForEnquiries, partneredEstates. Every address field and monthOfBirth and yearOfBirth are taken out before landing and never read.

by: insolvency (fork of integrator-9d788fb), step 8.4's lane once subscribed; to be appended by the integrator at the merge
title: One page of the Insolvency Register API's search (GET /insolvencies, JSON): estates by adjudication date range and register

landmarks: a JSON object carrying searchResults (a list) and totalItems, page, pageSize, totalPages, searchCriteria
each result an estateNumber, estateName, nzbn, adjudicationOrLiquidationDate, insolvencyTypeDescription, insolvencyStatus, multipleInsolvencies, alternateNames

signals_note: The bulk route the API keeps for holders of a copy; totalItems is the API's own count, read by check.against_api.
notes: addressAtAdjudication is taken out before landing. A result carries no discharge date: a discharged estate is shown only once its detail gives one.

by: insolvency (fork of integrator-9d788fb), step 8.4's lane once subscribed; to be appended by the integrator at the merge
title: One page of the Insolvency Register API's removals and corrections (GET /insolvencies/removalorcorrections, JSON)

landmarks: a JSON object carrying removedOrCorrectedInsolvencies (a list) and totalItems
each entry an estateNumber and removedDate

signals_note: Asked at least daily (the API's own term for a holder of a copy); only estateNumber and removedDate are read.
notes: The API says it deliberately gives only estate numbers and links; its definition's example carries more fields, every address field taken out before landing and none read.
